name: Short 7 - nokia_isnt_dead
script: Everyone thinks Nokia died. It didn't. It sold the phone business, but it kept the part that actually mattered. Network equipment. Today Nokia sells telecom infrastructure to carriers around the world, including the 5G networks your phone runs on. The Nokia name still shows up on handsets too, licensed to another company. So the collapse was really a company quietly walking out of a market it had already lost.
